attribution: Photo: shannonholman, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Lottery_shop,_Yangon,_Myanmar.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.text: ဥစ္စာထွန်းလင်း
မိုးယံရွှေလမင်း

expect.query: မိုးယံရွှေလမင်း

notes: Lottery-ticket shop, Yangon. Target is the complete yellow board above the ticket cabinet (pink 'Ouksa Htun Lin' then blue 'Moe Yan Shwe La Min'). A decorative swash sits under ယ on both this board and the large top fascia; read as part of the lettering, not a dot-below. The large top fascia repeats 'မိုးယံ ရွှေလ...' but is cut off at the right. Distractors: banner of prize numbers in Burmese digits, red poster with winning-ticket list, framed photos.

author: Wonnral
attribution: Photo: Wonnral, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Myohaung_or_Myoe_Haung_Signboard_of_Kayin_Language_02.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Village welcome board, Kayin State: gold relief letters on a maroon panel in a gold frame, some paint peeling (no letters lost). Frontal and close. Distractor: blank white board at left. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Myohaung or Myoe Haung Signboard of Kayin Language 02.jpg

author: TS Lens
attribution: Photo: TS Lens, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Kyin_Sein_Vision_-_panoramio.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: White serif letters on a blue fascia over a closed optician's shop, Mawlamyine; dim evening light. 'KS' star logo at left. No Burmese on the target. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Lionslayer
attribution: Photo: Lionslayer, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bagan_Signboard.JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Small dark-brown name plate on a post at a road junction, Bagan, backlit and far away. The Burmese word above 'BAGAN' (begins like ပုဂံ, followed by a third glyph that may be မြို့) is too small and dark to transcribe, so only the Latin line is given. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Lionslayer
attribution: Photo: Lionslayer, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Saw_Township_Signboard.JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Red town welcome board with gold relief letters in an ornate gold frame, Saw Township, Magway Region; slightly angled, bright sun. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Wonnral
attribution: Photo: Wonnral, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Signboard_of_High_School_in_Khale.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.text: အခြေခံပညာဦးစီးဌာန
lines.latin: Akhyei-gan Pyinnya Oo-zi Htana (Department of Basic Education)

lines.text: အခြေခံပညာအထက်တန်းကျောင်း
lines.latin: Akhyei-gan Pyinnya Ahtet-tan Kyaung (Basic Education High School)

notes: Green tiled school board with white letters, Khale (Kha Lel), Kayin State; frontal. The first line is small print at the top. 'ခလယ်' (village) and the township sit side by side on the last row. A faded inscription on the plinth below is illegible. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Signboard of High School in Khale.jpg

author: jasoneppink
attribution: Photo: jasoneppink, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/38102495@N00/8435042460. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.text: အမြတေဆေးဆိုင်

notes: Blue panel in a red frame over the shop, Yangon, seen from above. Big stylised pink 'အမြတေ' then smaller 'ဆေးဆိုင်'. Distractors: Sports City sign (left, Burmese), yellow gold-shop sign and Intertrust Travels & Tours sign (right).

author: jasoneppink
attribution: Photo: jasoneppink, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/38102495@N00/8459704975. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.text: မဟာမုနိရုပ်ရှင်တော်

notes: Large rooftop frame sign at night with red outline Burmese letters and yellow Latin letters on horizontal slats, Mahamuni Pagoda, Mandalay. Seen from below; the slats run behind the letters.

author: Adam Jones from Kelowna, BC, Canada

notes: Curved shop sign, Pyin Oo Lwin: 'OZZY' written vertically in red script down both black side panels, with an Ozzy logo and red 'FASHION SHOP' on the central poster image (a small singer figure, not the subject). Seen from below.

author: Anagoria
attribution: Photo: Anagoria, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:20200207_083047_Downtown_Mawlamyaing_Myanmar_anagoria.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.text: သုခဝတီ ဥယျာဉ်

notes: Large green plant-nursery board, downtown Mawlamyine. Only the top line is transcribed; the lines below are hidden by potted plants. Distractors: True Money, Wave Money, mytel pay, OK$ and EasyPay banners, red gold-shop sign at left.

author: Anagoria
attribution: Photo: Anagoria, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:20200207_083201_Downtown_Mawlamyaing_Myanmar_anagoria.JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Green fascia of a closed phone shop, downtown Mawlamyine. The 'K' in 'OK' has lost its silver face (only the outline remains). A phone line below (09 numbers separated by underscores) is not transcribed: one digit in the first number is ambiguous (2 or 5). Distractors: blue Burmese sign at upper left, dot stickers on the pillar.

author: Khun Win Naung
attribution: Photo: Khun Win Naung, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Monywa_Signboard.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.latin: Anauk-myauk Taing Myo-daw - Monywa Myo (North-West Division capital - Monywa city)

notes: Ornate red-and-gold town gateway arch over the road into Monywa, white letters on the red lintel; seen from a vehicle at medium distance, evening light. Single line with a hyphen before the town name.

author: Vocorcopt
attribution: Photo: Vocorcopt, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pu_Lein_welcome_signboard_04.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.text: ကြာအင်းဆိပ်ကြီးမြို့နယ် ကရင်ပြည်နယ်
lines.latin: Kya-in-seikgyi Myone, Kayin Pyine (Kyain Seikgyi Township, Kayin State)

notes: Blue village welcome board on a plinth, mostly frontal, Kayin State. The last line has two parts separated by a gap (township, state). The marble plaque on the plinth below is illegible.

author: Kantabon
attribution: Photo: Kantabon, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Kyaukse_tsp_Signboard.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.text: မန္တလေးတိုင်း
ကျောက်ဆည်မြို့နယ်အစ

notes: Township boundary board with gold relief letters on a peeling green panel in a gold frame, on the Hanmyintmo-Myogyi-Ywangan-Aungban road; shot from below at an angle. Mile marker uses Burmese digits (၁၀/၆).

author: jasoneppink
attribution: Photo: jasoneppink, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/38102495@N00/8423433619. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Printed paper sign taped to a folding grille, Yangon, with a separate red 'NOW OPEN' sheet below it (not part of the name). Distractor: cut-off company fascia above ('...ANY LIMITED.' / '...AGODA ROAD, YANGON.').
